title: A note on the lower boundary condition for Ekman flows
summary: We show that the assumption of a stress-free boundary condition at a finite intermediate depth, namely, at the bottom of the Ekman layer, in the analysis of wind-driven ocean flows necessarily leads to an unphysical current profile. Indeed, if the $z$-derivative of the fluid velocity vanishes at a given depth, then this depth necessarily corresponds to a minimum of the velocity profile, with the velocity increasing beneath it.
